subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the highlighted word in the given sentence.

The negotiations were conducted in an **amicable** atmosphere, leading to a peaceful resolution.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Hostile**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"amicable"** means characterized by friendliness and goodwill, often used to describe a situation, relationship, or negotiation conducted without conflict. (मित्रतापूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example: **The two countries reached an amicable agreement after weeks of discussion.
 
 
 
• **"Hostile"** means unfriendly, antagonistic, or showing opposition; it is the opposite of amicable. (शत्रुतापूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example: **The debate turned hostile when neither side was willing to compromise.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'amicable'** is **'hostile'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Hostile**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Agreeable **(सहमत होने योग्य): Pleasant, willing to agree, or acceptable to everyone.

 
 
• **Example:** The terms of the contract were agreeable to both parties.
 
 
 
• **Serene **(शांत): Calm, peaceful, and untroubled.
 
 
• **Example: **We enjoyed the serene beauty of the mountain lake.
 
 
 
• **Cordial **(हार्दिक): Warm and friendly in attitude or behavior.
 
 
• **Example:** The host greeted us with a cordial smile as we entered the party.
